description:
Use this when you need Türkiye national statutory public-holiday status. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a company, school, bank, exchange, collective-agreement or local closure calendar.
What it computes: Checks a date against Türkiye's statutory public holidays and explicit 13:00 half-day events for 2026-2027.
Example user requests: Is 2027-03-08 a Türkiye working day? | Does 2026-05-26 have a Turkish half-day holiday?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-03-08"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, half_day_start_time, non_working_fraction, weekend_days, calendar_scope, half_day_policy, rest_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Türkiye Saturday/Sunday baseline and no published full-day or half-day statutory holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/turkey-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/turkey-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned Türkiye 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_turkey_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Türkiye statutory national public holidays only.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend, general holiday or half-day general holiday.

half_day_start_time.description: 13:00 when an official half-day applies; empty string otherwise.

holiday_names.description: Turkish statutory holiday events applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: False for the Saturday/Sunday baseline, a full statutory holiday, or a published half-day holiday; half-day details are returned separately.

non_working_fraction.description: 1 for a full-day holiday, 0.5 for a published half-day, and 0 for a regular day.

rest_day_policy.description: Private and sector-specific closures are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Türkiye Statutory Public-Holiday Working Day
